summary: This directory serves as the root entry point for the JSDoc automation package, orchestrating the integration of core components including snapshotting, code update workflows, path utility functions, and complex domain analysis models.
responsibilities: Orchestrate core JSDoc analysis and update workflows
Expose unified APIs for project snapshots and structural changes
Integrate shared path utilities and domain models for consistent processing
Provide entry points for external consumers to access documentation update services
relationships: The core update workflow relies on snapshot data to identify structural changes within the project environment.
Path utilities support both snapshotting and update processes by ensuring consistent file resolution.
Complexity analysis models provide metadata that informs the JSDoc generation and update lifecycle.
designDecisions: Facade pattern for exposing sub-module functionality
Modular architecture separating lifecycle management from utility operations
Centralized export strategy to simplify package consumption
Layered separation between project state, transformation logic, and auxiliary path handling
